description: Required schema for repository-local authority registries.

authoritativeFor: Local specs/authority.json structure and authority-role separation.

requiredFields.repositoryId: Canonical repository identifier matching the Docs registry.
requiredFields.subjects: Non-empty array of local normative subject records.

instanceContract.authority: Optional local authority metadata; authority is represented by the global Docs registry and subject records.
instanceContract.crosslinks: Optional local links; they do not replace global authority-map links.
instanceContract.subjects: Every active normative profile or schema owned by this repository must have one subject.

subjectRequiredFields.kind: directive, specification, workflow, runbook, index, schema, module-area, record, desired-state, or test-suite.
subjectRequiredFields.authority: Exactly one repository-relative path and optional anchor.
subjectRequiredFields.directives: Non-empty links with directive path and IDs or namespaces.
subjectRequiredFields.implementation: Implementation paths and roles; implementation does not create authority.
subjectRequiredFields.consumers: Consumers that do not own the subject.
subjectRequiredFields.reviewers: Reviewers that do not own the subject.
subjectRequiredFields.evidence: Validation or acceptance references; evidence is not authority.

rules: Each repository has exactly one specs/authority.json.
repositoryId matches one Docs authority-map.json repositoryRegistry entry.
The global map points to local authority.json only, never directly to directive JSONs.
Every global governs ID resolves to exactly one local subject.
Each active subject has exactly one normative path/anchor target.
Local subjects cannot claim cross-repository authority beyond the global registry entry.
Authority maps cannot contain live task history, secrets, credentials, runtime output, or generated state.
Broken links, duplicate IDs, duplicate normative targets, unsupported delegation, or uncovered normative content fail validation.

anchorRules.json: Use a stable dotted key or named record anchor.
anchorRules.markdown: Use a stable heading anchor only when the heading is normative.
anchorRules.module: Use an exported symbol or named module-area anchor.
anchorRules.unknown: Use no anchor rather than inventing a non-resolving anchor.
